description: Create the React + Vite frontend in frontend/ directory. The public/ directory contains a CDN-based prototype that is NOT a build system — ignore it. Create a proper Vite project from scratch. Fix the Docker multi-stage build and docker-compose.yml. Create railway.toml and update .env.example. This feature is independent of FEAT-002 (tests) but depends on FEAT-001 (SecurityConfig must permit static assets for the frontend to load).
steps: 1. Create frontend/package.json with exact pinned versions: react@18.3.1, react-dom@18.3.1, @vitejs/plugin-react@4.3.1, vite@5.4.2. Scripts: dev, build, preview.
2. Create frontend/vite.config.js: import react plugin; dev proxy /api -> http://localhost:8080; outDir: 'dist'.
3. Create frontend/index.html: standard Vite HTML entrypoint with <div id='root'> and <script type='module' src='/src/main.jsx'>.
4. Create frontend/src/main.jsx: ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<App />). Import App and index.css.
5. Create frontend/src/index.css: minimal reset and layout styles. No external CSS CDN dependencies.

6. Create frontend/src/api.js: all fetch calls use relative URLs (no hardcoded base URL). Export: createUrl(accessKey, secretKey, originalUrl, customAlias), listUrls(accessKey, secretKey), deleteUrl(accessKey, secretKey, id), getUrlClicks(accessKey, secretKey, id), getGlobalClicks(accessKey, secretKey). Each function sends X-Access-Key and X-Secret-Key headers. Never log or embed credentials in bundle.

7. Create frontend/src/App.jsx: top-level state: { accessKey: '', secretKey: '', authenticated: false, error: null }. If not authenticated, render <ApiKeyForm>. If authenticated, render <UrlForm> and <UrlList>. On 401 response anywhere, clear credentials and set authenticated=false to re-show form.

8. Create frontend/src/components/ApiKeyForm.jsx: form with two password-type inputs for Access Key and Secret Key. On submit, attempt listUrls() — if 200, set authenticated=true; if 401, show 'Invalid credentials' error. Never store credentials outside component state (no localStorage).

9. Create frontend/src/components/UrlForm.jsx: form with URL input and optional custom alias input. On submit, calls createUrl(); on success refreshes URL list; on 409 shows 'Alias already in use'; on 400 shows validation error from response body.

10. Create frontend/src/components/UrlList.jsx: fetches URL list on mount and after create/delete. Renders list of <UrlRow> components. Shows loading spinner while fetching. Shows 'No URLs yet' when empty.

11. Create frontend/src/components/UrlRow.jsx: displays originalUrl, shortCode as clickable link, clickCount, createdAt. Copy-to-clipboard button for the short URL. Delete button (confirms before calling deleteUrl()). Analytics button that toggles showing <Analytics> for this URL.
12. Create frontend/src/components/Analytics.jsx: calls getUrlClicks() on mount; displays table of click events (clickedAt, ipAddress, userAgent, referrer). Shows loading and empty states.

13. Rewrite Dockerfile as 3-stage build: Stage 1 (node:20-alpine AS frontend-build): COPY frontend/package.json frontend/package-lock.json ./; RUN npm ci --silent; COPY frontend/ .; RUN npm run build. Stage 2 (maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21 AS backend-build): COPY pom.xml .; RUN mvn -B dependency:go-offline -q; COPY src ./src; COPY --from=frontend-build /frontend/dist ./src/main/resources/static; RUN mvn -B package -DskipTests -q. Stage 3 (eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine): addgroup/adduser app; COPY --from=backend-build jar; USER app; EXPOSE 8080; ENTRYPOINT java -jar /app/app.jar. Do NOT copy .m2/settings.xml.

14. Fix docker-compose.yml app service: REMOVE 'entrypoint: []' and 'command: [...]' lines entirely. Keep the environment block as-is (SPRING_DATA_REDIS_HOST, SPRING_DATA_REDIS_PORT, SPRING_DATASOURCE_*, SPRING_RABBITMQ_*, APP_BASE_URL are already correctly set).

15. Create railway.toml at project root: [build] builder=DOCKERFILE dockerfilePath=Dockerfile; [deploy] startCommand='java -jar /app/app.jar' healthcheckPath='/actuator/health' healthcheckTimeout=60 restartPolicyType=ON_FAILURE restartPolicyMaxRetries=3.

16. Update .env.example: ensure all env vars have placeholder values — SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL, SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME, SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD, SPRING_DATA_REDIS_HOST, SPRING_DATA_REDIS_PORT, SPRING_RABBITMQ_HOST, SPRING_RABBITMQ_PORT, SPRING_RABBITMQ_USERNAME, SPRING_RABBITMQ_PASSWORD, APP_BASE_URL, SERVER_PORT. No real credentials.
17. Run npm install in frontend/ to generate package-lock.json (required for npm ci in Docker build).
acceptance_criteria: frontend/package.json exists with vite and react dependencies at pinned versions
cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build exits 0
frontend/dist/index.html and frontend/dist/assets/ created after build
No API base URL is hardcoded in any frontend source file
No credentials appear in any frontend source file
Dockerfile has 3 FROM stages — node, maven, eclipse-temurin:jre — and does NOT copy .m2/settings.xml
docker-compose.yml app service has no entrypoint or command overrides
.env.example has all required env vars with placeholder values only
verification: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build  (exit 0; dist/ created)
curl http://localhost:8080/  (returns HTML with React app, not 403)
findings:
All steps completed successfully.

frontend/npm ci && npm run build: EXIT 0. dist/index.html and dist/assets/ produced (3 files: index.html, assets/index-M5J-QX-u.css 2.16kB, assets/index-vpCpVjQG.js 152kB).

docker compose build: All 26 stages completed. Image url-shortner-app:latest built (421MB). Note: PowerShell shows exit code 1 due to Docker writing progress to stderr; the image was confirmed present via 'docker images url-shortner-app'.

Dockerfile: 3 stages — node:20-alpine (frontend-build), maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21 (backend-build), eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine (runtime). No .m2/settings.xml copied.

docker-compose.yml: entrypoint/command overrides removed from app service.

railway.toml: created at project root.

.env.example: updated with all required placeholder env vars including SERVER_PORT.

api.js correction: getGlobalClicks() uses /api/urls/clicks (matching actual UrlController mapping at @GetMapping('/clicks') under @RequestMapping('/api/urls')), not /api/clicks as originally specified in FEAT-003 step 6. No base URL hardcoded anywhere.

Note: 2 npm audit vulnerabilities (1 moderate, 1 high) in dev dependencies — these are build-time only and do not affect the production bundle.
